text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and I are on our way home from a race, when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There's a bunch of people up ahead… You think there's a sale or something?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Why don't you give it a go? Yes, you, with your hair tied back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, a raffle! It's not like I can say no if you're asking! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You bet I do! I got one when I paid at the driving range earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm like one of those people that needs to have all my tickets and point cards on me at all times. Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Such mundane, everyday habits like that may not be typical of a noble lady, but they're very much typical of Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's pull the lever together! Hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Time to get this party started! Gimme a good one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Excited, Mejiro Palmer and I spin the lever together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-a hot spring?! No waaay! I really got the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh wow! I didn't think getting hyped would actually get me the hot spring party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, the party vibes in me are getting out of hand! I need to caaaalm down. Breathe iiin, and ouuut…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, thanks… I'm super happy, but I also feel, like, kinda pressured now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna go, I've gotta do it right. Now I gotta look up stuff about the area, make an itinerary…
choice_data_list: You don't need to do all that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I… don't? But whenever the Mejiro family goes out, I practically always do all the prep work…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not going to be able to relax if she does all that. So…
choice_data_list: You're banned from doing any logistical work. Your only job there will be to have fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you mean I can just be no work, all play?! Huh, that's pretty lit. But… can I really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've always done something for these kinda outings, so I don't think I'm gonna be able to just sit back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've gotta do something so I don't feel guilty at least… Oh, I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about I make the trip a reward for myself if I do well in the Twinkle Series? I think I can kick back in that case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then it's a plan! I'll work really hard so I can have a hot spring party afterward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! Now I'm getting hyped again! All riiiight! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is burning with motivation. Now she has something great to aim for after her big runaway!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooh! What a get! Looks juicy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This hamburger steak looks good, but the sauce that comes with it looks a little rich for my blood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You think it's okay if I season it myself?
choice_data_list: How about putting some salt on it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I could… but just salt might be kinda bland.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let me use your kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you're down, I'll be our chef tonight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sizzle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Finiiished! Here, try some. I just seasoned it with some soy sauce and onions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At her insistence, I take a bite…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So? How is it?
choice_data_list: It's got a very refreshing flavor! I like it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha! Right?! It's nothing fancy, but it's pretty healthy since it's low in sodium.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll have some too. I made some rice and soup too, so help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer turns her deluxe hamburger steak into a full-course impromptu dinner party.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooh, that's not bad! Look how many we got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm… I would've brought a cart or something if I knew we'd be getting all this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, I mean a golf cart. It'd be way easier to bring all these back to the dorm if we had one with us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Not like I have a golf cart or a car, though. You can bet I'd be going on drives all the time if I did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, no use sitting here daydreaming about shoulda, woulda, couldas. I'll just have to carry them myself!
choice_data_list: I'll help! We can both carry them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You sure? I'm the type to just do everything myself…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But if you're offering, I guess I'll take you up on it. Let's carry them together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We carry the carrots back to my office and decide to cook them one by one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Chomp! Hm… Mm…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mmm! These taste so sweet and delicious! Especially after working so hard to carry them over here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You eat up too, Trainer! You've gotta be paid properly for your work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She insists, so I try one. Just as Mejiro Palmer said, it tastes extra delectable after doing all that heavy lifting.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Awww, just one? I thought we put some good energy into it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Welp, whatever. Carrots are lucky vegetables in my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just take a close look. What does the shape remind you of?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooh, you guessed it! It's a rocket! And a rocket signifies a rocket start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I tend to win my races by bursting out the gates like a rocket and then slaying with my runaway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Not a bad way to look at it, right?! That's what I call positive thinking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's eat it on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The prize is nothing to write home about, but Mejiro Palmer doesn't seem too bothered about it.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa… No way…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer… There's only one thing to do in times like these.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: When you're confronted with a reality you just can't handle, all you gotta do is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Run awaaaaay! I saw nothing! Nothing! I don't accept it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No tissues here! Nothiiing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She claims not to have seen anything, but Mejiro Palmer still looks rather upset.
